text.description_html:
8 x 34 Inch Dark Anodized Aluminum Kick Plate

These are made of Solid Aluminum with dark anodized finish and ship complete with matching finish mounting screws.

Kick Plates are typically the width of the door less 2 inches. If your door is 36 inches wide you would install a 34 inch wide kick plate.

Other Door Kick Plates Available:
6" High Solid Brass
8" High Solid Brass
6" High Stainless Steel
